## Summary and evidence

Describe the change, commands run, expected/actual results and numerical differences.

- [ ] Equations/constraints and scientific assumptions are unchanged, or changes are documented.
- [ ] Units, input schema and sign conventions are explicit.
- [ ] Data/code provenance and redistribution rights are recorded.
- [ ] Calculation, physics and failure-path tests cover the change.
- [ ] Solver status and termination are checked where applicable.
- [ ] Reference-output changes are regenerated and explained, not selected for nicer results.
- [ ] Benchmark/performance effects and unverified claims are identified.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated caches or unrelated edits are included.
